culpritSource.quote: The culprit is Hatsuho Hojo. After that, he shows a picture that shows Hatsuho, when she was a graduated highschool student in sailor suit, and her father, who is revealed to be Keiichi Saegusa, the president of Saegusa industries who committed suicide.

motive.quote: Since she couldn't see the katana from her position, it means that the culprit is left-handed.

method.quote: When they first saw it, they jumped to the conclusion that it was used only as a weapon.

evidence.quote: Conan stuns Kogoro and said that on Genichiro's murder, the culprit attempt to cover his tracks with the footprint technique he explained earlier, but in that case anyone other than Tatsuko, who saw the armor could have done it.

motive.zhHans: 由于从她的位置看不到那把刀，说明犯人是左撇子。她本打算第二天再处理掉，因为那时没有别人会用厨房；但小兰最后进来帮她冲咖啡，那个机会就没了。他一向笑着接下大門工业提出的无理要求，因为双方是多年的生意伙伴。社长卖掉了铠甲来筹钱给员工发薪。在东京工作时，她改了名字，并住进源一郎的家，这样既能替父亲了却遗憾，也能在父亲忌日这天完成复仇。
motive.en: Since she couldn't see the katana from her position, it means that the culprit is left-handed. She intended to dispose of them the next day, since no one else would be using the kitchen, but Ran ended up coming in to help her with the coffee, so the opportunity to do so was lost. He accepted unreasonable orders from Daimon Industries with a smile, since they had been trading partners for ages. The CEO sold the armor to raise money to pay his employees. When she was working in Tokyo, she changed her name and began to live on Genichiro's house so that she could absolve her father of his regret and so that she could have her revenge on the anniversary of her father's death.

method.zhHans: 他们第一次看到它时，就直接断定它只是被当作武器使用。它还有一个特别阴险的用途：把音响室变成密室。犯人杀死一树之后，给他穿上铠甲，再把刀插进门边的墙里。接着，他们把刀的另一端搭在门把上，然后缓慢而稳妥地退出房间，不让刀倒下，并借门关上的力量让刀把门闩推上——密室就这样完成了。他们知道没人有力气打开上了死闩的门，也知道硬把门撞开会令刀掉到地上、暴露手法——至少犯人是这么想的。她本打算第二天再处理掉，因为那时没有别人会用厨房；但小兰最后进来帮她冲咖啡，那个机会就没了。
method.en: When they first saw it, they jumped to the conclusion that it was used only as a weapon. It had another particularly sneaky purpose: to turn the audio room into a locked room. After the culprit killed Kazuki, they dressed him in the armor, then stabbed the katana into the wall near the door. Then, with the other end of the katana they rested it upon the door handle, then slowly but surely exited the room without letting the katana fall and used the force of the closing door to make the katana bolt the lock with this the sealed room was complete. They knew that no one would have the strength to open the dead-bolted door and they also knew that trying to break the door down would cause the katana to fall to the floor, leaving the trick would unexposed or so the culprit thought. She intended to dispose of them the next day, since no one else would be using the kitchen, but Ran ended up coming in to help her with the coffee, so the opportunity to do so was lost.

evidence.zhHans: 柯南麻醉了小五郎，指出在源一郎那起命案中，犯人试图用他先前讲过的足迹手法掩盖行踪；但若真如此，除见过铠甲的辰子之外，其他人也都有可能作案。他们第一次看到它时，就直接断定它只是被当作武器使用。然而那把刀并不只是一种武器。犯人利用了传说，留下那些巨大的脚印，让人以为唯一的嫌疑人只有那位铠甲武士，从而骗他们相信是一树杀了源一郎、随后自杀。
evidence.en: Conan stuns Kogoro and said that on Genichiro's murder, the culprit attempt to cover his tracks with the footprint technique he explained earlier, but in that case anyone other than Tatsuko, who saw the armor could have done it. When they first saw it, they jumped to the conclusion that it was used only as a weapon. However, the katana wasn't just a weapon. The culprit took advantage of the legend and left those large footprints to make it seem as though the only possible culprit was the armored warrior, and fool them into believing Kazuki killed Genichiro and committed suicide shortly thereafter.

resolution.zhHans: 柯南麻醉了小五郎，指出在源一郎那起命案中，犯人试图用他先前讲过的足迹手法掩盖行踪；但若真如此，除见过铠甲的辰子之外，其他人也都有可能作案。最可能的情况是：杀死源一郎之后，犯人身上溅到了血。然而铠甲和一树的衣服上都没有血迹。犯人杀死源一郎之后，又进到音响室杀了一树。
resolution.en: Conan stuns Kogoro and said that on Genichiro's murder, the culprit attempt to cover his tracks with the footprint technique he explained earlier, but in that case anyone other than Tatsuko, who saw the armor could have done it. Most likely, after killing Genichiro, the culprit was splattered with blood. However, neither the armor nor Kazuki's clothes have been stained. After the culprit killed Genichiro, they came into the audio room and killed Kazuki.
